sources.catalogDeclaredLicense: 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版

boundedIntervalComparison.interpretation: No change was observed in this short interval. This is not evidence that the source has immutable versions, no corrections, or complete intraday coverage.

positiveEvidence: Both official exchange datasets returned HTTP 200 and the advertised nine-field disclosure schema.
Both datasets preserve a source publication date and time plus fact date, clause, subject and full explanation.
The government catalog declares daily update frequency and Open Government Data License v1 for these datasets.
Raw payload hashes and capture clocks make the observed snapshots replay-auditable.
counterevidence: The catalog frequency is daily, not an authenticated low-latency publication SLA.
A row's source publication time does not prove when that row became available through this API. capturedAt remains the conservative decision-time upper bound.
Neither observed schema exposes a native provider item ID, version ID, correction flag or supersession link.

Several rows share 07:00:04 while their fact dates are months earlier and their text describes multi-month announcement periods. They are high-risk recurring-disclosure or stale-information candidates, not automatically new economic events.
Two identical payloads 55 seconds apart prove only local stability, not archive completeness or absence of later correction.
No general-news coverage is provided and the licensed production general-news lane remains SOURCE_NEEDED.

pitRules.sourcePublishedAt: Descriptive source clock only until availability is independently authenticated.
pitRules.firstKnownAtConservative: Use capturedAt for replay eligibility in this pilot.
pitRules.revisionHandling: Append every changed capture; never overwrite an earlier receipt.
pitRules.absenceHandling: No row is UNKNOWN unless a complete expected polling window and successful source coverage receipt are present. A single daily snapshot cannot prove NO_KNOWN_EVENT.

biasControls.selectionBias: All rows returned by both sources were counted; no symbol, sentiment, event class or outcome filter was applied.
biasControls.lookAhead: No later row or correction may be backdated to sourcePublishedAt; capturedAt controls replay eligibility.
biasControls.dataSnooping: No return, price, ranking, threshold or horizon was inspected.
biasControls.overfit: No event-class-specific scoring or text model was fit.
biasControls.duplicateNews: Article/disclosure identity and economic event identity remain separate. Repeated-period notices are candidate syndication/republication until a version chain is proven.
biasControls.dataQuality: Native version identity, archive completeness and intraday API availability are UNKNOWN.
biasControls.cost: Observed two-source payload volume was small, but this two-poll pilot is not a production cost or rate-limit benchmark.
biasControls.redundancy: The official lane supplies primary disclosure facts. It does not replace general-news discovery, attention, sector or supply-chain evidence.

systemValue.system1: Research-only provenance and replay guard. Current ANNOUNCEMENTS date/title normalization remains too coarse; no Formal gate or risk score changes.
systemValue.system2: Potential canonical event-truth input after prospective coverage/version proof. No news factor or L5 decision input is activated.

maturityDecision.D11-08: Remain L2: a source publication clock is observed, but API availability time and complete revision history are not validated.
maturityDecision.D17-01: Remain L2: official lane reliability dimensions improved, general-news production source remains missing.
maturityDecision.D17-02: Remain L2: capturedAt-safe replay is feasible, but first-known latency distribution and intraday completeness are not established.
maturityDecision.D17-09: Remain L2: recurring-disclosure risk is observed, but multi-day version/cluster truth is not yet available.

exactNextContinuation: Run an independent multi-day, fixed-cadence, source-only capture across at least three trading sessions and one after-hours interval, storing immutable raw hashes and expected/observed poll counts.
Quantify capture delay from sourcePublishedAt to capturedAt without assuming the API was unavailable before capture.
Classify cross-day recurring-period notices, additions, removals and changed content; removals remain UNKNOWN unless rolling-window semantics are proven.
Seek a native MOPS disclosure identifier/correction linkage or retain derived-identity revision chains as unverified.
Keep the licensed general-news production lane SOURCE_NEEDED and keep all outcome joins closed.
